name: Trivang Bhasma

sections.overview: Trivang Bhasma – Uses, Benefits, Indications, Side Effects and Dosage
sections.introduction:
Trivang Bhasma is an Ayurvedic calcined formulation made from three elements Tin, lead and zinc. This formulation is very useful in curing diabetes, urinary disorders, premature ejaculation and generalized weakness. It shows its effects mainly on testes, ovaries, uterus, nerves and urinary bladder. The consumption of this formulation provides strength and important minerals and vitamins to the body. It should be used in a small dosage. 
 Trivang Bhasma Ingredients 

 Purified lead 
 Purified zinc 
 Purified tin 
 Sufficient amount of powdered Cannabis sativa and Papaver somniferum 

 Method of Trivang Bhasma Preparation 
 Mix the three purified elements and put them in an iron pan. Add the 2 powdered herbs slowly and gradually and mix rapidly till they become homogenous and in the form of a powder. Cover the pan with a lid and cook it for 12- 14 hours on high heat. When the mixture changes its color to a deep red, turn the flame off. Let it cool then strain it with a muslin cloth and triturate it with fresh Aloe Vera juice. After it dries off, heat it in a sealed container 7 times to obtain a yellow colored powder which is the final product. 
 Trivang Bhasma Dosage 
 125 mg twice a day after meals with butter or honey. 
 Trivang Bhasma Uses 

 Boosts immunity 
 Urinary disorders 
 Leucorrhea 
 Infertility 
 Underdeveloped female external and internal organs 
 Impotency in males 
 Anovulation 
 Night fall 
 Diabetes 
 Miscarriages 

 Trivang Bhasma Contraindications 

 It should be avoided during pregnancy and lactation. This formulation shouldn’t be given to kids. 
 Over dosage should be strictly avoided. 
 Self-medication is discouraged. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
